Seulement au cas où ce mode opératoire ne peut pas être utilisé vu que l’adjudicataire ne disposerait pas d’une adresse e-mail, le mode opératoire exceptionnel pourrait alors être appliqué. L’expéditeur en question devra veiller à recevoir effectivement un accusé de réception et devra le conserver. Le délai effectif de livraison ou d’exécution débute le jour qui suit le jour d’envoi de l’e-mail (sauf autre disposition prévue dans la lettre de commande). Le contrat, ordinaire et conclu sous la forme d’un accord-cadre mono-attributaire, prendra effet dès réception de sa notification par le titulaire pour une durée d’une année reconductible tacitement trois fois, sans que sa durée totale ne puisse excéder quatre ans (article L. 2125-1 1° du code de la commande publique). Mais il relève aussi du dilemme quand vient l’instant de désigner les vainqueurs. Falls ja, welche Nachweise sind hierfür im Rahmen des Teilnahmeantrags bzw. Angebots erforderlich? Nein, neben festangestellten Mitarbeitenden können keine freien Mitarbeitende berücksichtigt werden (Dokument Erklärung zur Eignung, Punkt 2.2.1 Mitarbeiter) Sollten die geforderten personellen Eignungen mit den eigenen festangestellten Mitarbeitenden nicht vollständig erfüllt werden können, besteht die Möglichkeit, • eine Bietergemeinschaft zu bilden oder • eine Eignungsleihe in Anspruch zu nehmen. Die jeweils erforderlichen Nachweise sind dann gemäß den Vorgaben der Vergabeunterlagen im Angebot beizubringen. Anhaenge, Seite: 2 lfd. Falls ja, welche Nachweise sind hierfür im Rahmen des Teilnahmeantrags bzw. Angebots erforderlich? Nein, neben festangestellten Mitarbeitenden können keine freien Mitarbeitende berücksichtigt werden (Dokument Erklärung zur Eignung, Punkt 2.2.1 Mitarbeiter) Sollten die geforderten personellen Eignungen mit den eigenen festangestellten Mitarbeitenden nicht vollständig erfüllt werden können, besteht die Möglichkeit, • eine Bietergemeinschaft zu bilden oder • eine Eignungsleihe in Anspruch zu nehmen. Le DUME, qui a déjà été utilisé dans une procédure antérieure, pourra être réutilisé par le pouvoir adjudicateur à condition que les informations renseignées soient toujours valables et pertinentes par rapport aux exigences du pouvoir adjudicateur. Fourniture, installation, formation et accompagnement Le marché comprend la fourniture des logiciels, des licences nécessaires et la mise à disposition d’une documentation complète en langue française. L’adjudicataire devra assurer leur installation, leur paramétrage et les tests de bon fonctionnement au maximum en présentiel chez l’adjudicateur (inhouse) jusqu’à la réception finale de l’implémentation. sion des prix Les prix relatifs aux prestations récurrentes de l’étape 2 ainsi que les tarifs journaliers applicables aux développements spécifiques éventuels sont révisables une fois par an, au 1er avril. La première révision intervient le 1er avril 2028. La révision est calculée selon la formule suivante : P = P₀ × [0,80 × (S/S₀) + 0,20] avec : P = prix révisé ; P₀ = prix contractuel avant révision ; S = valeur de l’indice des coûts salariaux de référence Agoria Digital pour le secteur numérique applicable au mois précédant la date de révision ; S₀ = valeur du même indice de référence applicable au mois précédant la date limite de réception des offres ; 0,80 = part du prix considéré comme représentative des coûts salariaux ; 0,20 = terme fixe non révisable. La révision s’applique tant à la hausse qu’à la baisse. Les prix relatifs aux prestations d’implémentation, de migration, de reprise des données, de mise en exploitation et de formation exécutées dans le cadre de l’étape 1 ne font pas l’objet d’une révision. staffing_team.text: teformes d’intégration. Monitoring des applications et des transactions de bout en bout, avec des capacités de détection des anomalies, de diagnostic accéléré, d’analyse des dépendances et d’identification des causes racines. Monitoring de l’expérience utilisateur, tant réelle que synthétique, pour les applications et les parcours utilisateurs critiques. Collecte, centralisation, normalisation, corrélation et exploitation des données de télémétrie, incluant les métriques, événements, logs et traces. Mise à disposition de tableaux de bord adaptés aux différents rôles et niveaux de responsabilité, notamment la direction, les opérations IT, les équipes applicatives, le NOC/support et les responsables d’applications et de services. Définition, mesure et suivi des indicateurs de niveau de service, notamment les SLI/SLO, les golden signals et les error budgets, ainsi que les mécanismes d’alerte associés. Intégration avec les outils et processus ITSM existants, notamment pour la gestion des incidents, des problèmes, des changements, des escalades, du reporting et des revues de service. Mise en place de mécanismes d’alerting intelligents, permettant la réduction du bruit, la corrélation des alertes, leur priorisation en fonction de l’impact métier et leur routage vers les équipes responsables.

(MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

references_experience.text: ncil can continue to fulfil its statutory function of distributing public funding to the arts sector securely, reliably, and efficiently. The objective of this procurement is to secure a modern, cloud-hosted, configurable off-the-shelf Grant Management System capable of supporting the full grant lifecycle for applicants, assessors, panellists, and Arts Council staff. The solution will provide a secure and accessible digital platform for application management, assessment workflows, award administration, post-award monitoring, reporting, and integration with the Arts Council’s existing Finance Management System. The organisation's strategic preference is for a solution that requires minimal custom development and can be configured using standard platform functionality. The replacement programme will be delivered through a phased implementation approach centred on the successful completion of a Proof of Concept (PoC) using a live Arts Council funding programme. This approach is intended to validate vendor capability, system performance, user experience, and organisational readiness before progressing to full production deployment. The Arts Council is seeking a long-term technology partner capable of delivering a proven solution while supporting a structured, low-risk transition from the e

For further information on the Arts Council, please visit our website www.artscouncil.ie. Background and Objective The Arts Council is undertaking the replacement of its existing Grant Management System (GMS), a critical business application that underpins the administration, assessment, award, and ongoing management of public funding programmes. The current platform has been in operation beyond its supported lifecycle for over a decade and now presents significant operational, cybersecurity, governance, and business continuity risks. The replacement programme has therefore been established primarily as a risk mitigation and service continuity initiative to ensure the Arts Council can continue to fulfil its statutory function of distributing public funding to the arts sector securely, reliably, and efficiently. The objective of this procurement is to secure a modern, cloud-hosted, configurable off-the-shelf Grant Management System capable of supporting the full grant lifecycle for applicants, assessors, panellists, and Arts Council staff. The solution will provide a secure and accessible digital platform for application

e, user experience, and organisational readiness before progressing to full production deployment. The Arts Council is seeking a long-term technology partner capable of delivering a proven solution while supporting a structured, low-risk transition from the existing environment. The new system must support bilingual service delivery (Irish and English), modern digital user experiences, robust security controls, workflow automation, management reporting, and interoperability with current and future finance platforms. The solution should also align with public sector best practice, including cloud-first principles, accessibility requirements, data protection obligations, cybersecurity standards, and emerging NIS2 requirements. This procurement will be conducted through a Competitive Procedure with Negotiation to ensure transparency, value for money, and market competition. The successful solution will play a central role in enabling The Arts Council to maintain resilient grant administration services while providing a platform for future enhancement and digital innovation across the organisation. O tratamento dos dados pessoais encontra-se limitado, nos termos do artigo 6.º, n.º 1, alíneas b) e c) do RGPD, a finalidades exclusivamente relacionadas com a execução da prestação de serviços ou com o cumprimento de obrigações jurídicas a que o ULSSM e o prestador de serviços estejam adstritos. 3. O ULSSM e o prestador de serviços assumem a obrigação de estrita confidencialidade relativamente a todos os dados pessoais de que venham a ter conhecimento no âmbito do contrato, extensiva à informação a que os seus trabalhadores, agentes, subcontratados e consultores tenham acesso, garantindo que os mesmos assumiram um compromisso de confidencialidade. 4. Aanbesteder en opdracht Aanbesteder Departement Zorg Referentienummer DZ/2026/PGB/017 /Kennissurveillance_MGZ_pub01 Titel Ontwikkeling van een AI-gemedieerd kennissurveillancesysteem voor milieugezondheidszorg Het team Milieugezondheidszorg van het Departement Zorg staat in voor de voorbereiding, uitvoering en onderbouwing van het preventieve gezondheidsbeleid inzake milieugezondheidszorg in Vlaanderen. Milieugezondheidszorg is het onderdeel van het preventieve gezondheidsbeleid dat door een multidisciplinaire benadering, met minstens de wetenschappelijke disciplines geneeskunde, toxicologie, epidemiologie, gezondheidszorg, milieutechnologie en milieuku

sen in dossiers, risicoanalyses, beleidsvoorbereiding en advisering. Deze initiatieven kennen hun wettelijke basis in het preventiedecreet, het decreet algemene bepalingen Milieubeleid m.b.t. de milieuhygiënische aspecten, het MER-decreet; en worden ingezet cf. de prioritering van de gezondheidsdoelstelling Milieugezondheidszorg en het klimaatgezondheidsplan. De beoogde oplossing ondersteunt menselijke expertise maar vervangt deze niet. Interpretatie, validatie en beleidsmatige duiding blijven steeds de verantwoordelijkheid van inhoudelijke experten. ESB was established in 1927 as a statutory corporation in the Republic of Ireland under the Electricity (Supply) Act 1927. With a holding of approximately 97.1%, ESB is majority owned by the Irish Government. The remaining approximate 2.9% is held by the trustees of an Employee Share Ownership Plan. As a strong, diversified, vertically integrated utility, ESB operates right across the electricity market: from generation, through transmission and distribution, to supply. In addition, ESB extracts further value at certain points along this chain: supplying gas, using our networks to carry fibre for telecommunications, developing electric vehicle public charging infrastructure and more. ESB is a leading Irish utility focused on providing excellent customer service and maintaining our financial strength. We have a regulated asset base of approximately €12 billion with 30% of electricity generation capacity in the all-island market.

Ein Lieferant möchte auf die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit zurückgreifen (wie im Königlichen Erlass vom 18. Juni 2017, Artikel 72§1, vorgesehen). Ein Lieferant kann einen Qualifizierungsantrag stellen und für die Qualifizierungskriterien, die Anforderungen in Bezug auf die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle oder technische Leistungsfähigkeit sowie berufliche Befähigung enthalten (3.3.2 und 3.3.3), die Kapazitäten anderer Wirtschaftseinheiten in Anspruch nehmen. Mit anderer Wirtschaftseinheit ist eine andere (natürliche oder juristische) Person als der Lieferant selbst gemeint. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so gibt er dies in der Frage in Teil II C der EEE an. Möchte ein Lieferant die Mittel einer anderen Wirtschaftseinheit in Anspruch nehmen, so muss er zusätzlich zu einer EEE diese Wirtschaftseinheit veranlassen, den Abschnitt „Leistungsfähigkeit Dritter“ in Anhang 3 auszufüllen. Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. Het systeem moet standaardrapporten en realtime dashboards aanbieden en gegevens kunnen exporteren naar gangbare formaten en business intelligence -toepassingen. Dit moet toe laten om wachttijden, no -shows, capaciteit, piekmomenten en andere kernindicatoren efficiënt op te volgen en beleidsmatig te analyseren. De in het systeem opgeslagen data is eigendom van de stad en moet te allen tijde toegankelijk blijven voor de stad. Tot slot worden hoge eisen gesteld op het vlak van gebruiksvriendelijkheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid, beheer en toekomstbestendigheid. De oplossing moet voldoen aan: • de WCAG AA-toegankelijkheidsnormen; • responsive werken op verschillende toestellen (beeldschermen, telefoon, desktop) ; • beschikken over een fijnmazig rollen- en rechtenbeheer; • ondersteuning bieden voor Single Sign-On en; • open API’s voorzien voor toekomstige koppelingen. Referenčni posli morajo biti potrjeni s strani pristojne osebe. Pristojna oseba za podpis je bodisi zakoniti zastopnik oziroma oseba, ki razpolaga s pooblastilom za zastopanje gospodarskega subjekta oziroma oseba, ki ima pooblastilo za podpis potrdila, oziroma potrdilo podpiše oseba, ki je v delovni organizaciji pooblaščena za vodenje sektorja, kjer je bil referenčni projekt izveden. Die Attraktivität des Campusnetzes ergibt sich aus seiner etablierten Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur an einem dynamisch wachsenden Hochtechnologiestandort. Das Netz verfügt über eine bestehende Kundenbasis, gewachsene Leitungswege und Netzknoten sowie redundante Carrier-Anbindungen. Zusätzliche Entwicklungsperspektiven ergeben sich aus der fortlaufenden Erweiterung des Campus durch neue Gebäude, dem Ausbaupotenzial für Cloud-, Security- und UCC-Dienste sowie der Ergänzung durch ein lokales 5G-Campusnetz. Damit bietet das Campusnetz eine belastbare infrastrukturelle Grundlage mit weiterem wirtschaftlichem und technologischem Wachstumspotenzial. Die Beweggründe für den Verkauf durch die WISTA sind eine strategische Weiterentwicklung des Campusnetzes durch einen spezialisierten Provider, mit qualifiziertem Personal und dem notwendigen Knowhow. Es versorgt derzeit rund 400 Kunden sowie ca. 4.400 Teilnehmer im Voice-Bereich und ist damit ein wesentlicher Standortfaktor für Deutschlands größten Wissenschafts- und Technologiepark. Die vorhandene Infrastruktur umfasst eine leistungsfähige Kabelkanalanlage, ein Leitungsnetz auf Kupfer- und Glasfaserbasis, mit einer Gesamtlänge von knapp 20 Kilometern, sowie ein Gigabit-Ethernet-Backbone. Technisch genutzt werden insbesondere LWL-Backbone-Verbindungen, Monomode- und Multimode-Glasfaserkabel, Kupferkabel, Kupfer-Querkabel sowie FM-Kabel mit 100 Doppeladern. Ofertanții au obligația de a indica sau marca documentele/informațiile din propunerea tehnică pe care le declară ca fiind confidențiale, întrucât cuprind secrete tehnice și/sau comerciale, stabilite conform legii, iar dezvăluirea acestora ar prejudicia interesele legitime ale operatorilor economici, în special în ceea ce privește secretul comercial și proprietatea intelectuală. Caracterul confidențial trebuie demonstrat prin orice mijloace de probă. Cu excepția eventualelor constrângeri de natură tehnică și/sau legală, în cazul în care vor exista limitări, condiționări sau restricții impuse de ofertant în raport cu cerințele caietului de sarcini, oferta va fi declarată ca fiind neconformă. Specificațiile tehnice aferente caietului de sarcini reprezintă cerințe minimale referitoare la nivelul calitativ, tehnic si de performantă, scop în care soluțiile ofertate în cadrul propunerii tehnice pot face referire la atingerea unor niveluri superioare. Programme Aim The purpose of this training programme is to design, develop and deliver a training programme that build people’s understanding of self-harm and the role it plays in the life of a person who self-harms. The programme will build the knowledge and confidence of the learner to have a conversation if they are concerned that someone may be self-harming. The training programme should provide people who access it with a sense of hope and reassurance that people can build healthier coping mechanisms. Programme Objectives The training programme is intended to: Increase understanding of what self-harm is. Increase understanding of the relationship between self-harm and suicide. Build skills and confidence to engage with a person and speak openly about self-harm. Challenge the stigma surrounding self-harm Increase awareness of available supports and services Stage 1: An introduction to the subject of self-harm – communicating the ‘why’ functions of self-harm through lived experience experts. deliverables_scope.text: e Companies Act 2014 and related legislation. IAASA is committed to maintaining an accessible, secure and user- focused online presence that supports transparency, stakeholder engagement and the delivery of information to the public. IAASA invites tenders from suitably qualified service providers for the provision of website hosting, support, maintenance and content management services for its corporate website. The Authority requires a reliable, secure and accessible website platform which can be effectively managed by non-technical staff and which supports statutory accessibility obligations, user engagement and future development requirements. The successful tenderer will provide website hosting, technical support, maintenance, content management functionality, security management, training, performance monitoring and associated services in accordance with the requirements set out in this Request for Tender. 2. About the PSI – The Pharmacy Regulator The Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland (PSI), the pharmacy regulator, is a public body established by the Pharmacy Act 2007. The PSI is an aegis body of the Department of Health. Our mission is to assure patient safety and public trust in pharmacy through the effective regulation of pharmacists and pharmacies in Ireland. The role and responsibilities of the PSI are established in legislation. These include: • registration of pharmacists, pharmaceutical assistants and pharmacies (retail pharmacy businesses); • setting standards for pharmacy education and training and ensuring that all registered pharmacists are undertaking appropriate continuing professional development (CPD); • promoting good professional practice by pharmacists by raising standards and sharing information for the benefit of patients and the wider health system; • conducting fieldwork to assess how pharmacies comply with pharmacy and medicines law and, where necessary, act to address poor performance and/or unsafe practices. • consideration o

SCOPE OF SERVICE The Contractor shall provide enterprise -grade mobile and data services to the U.S. Embassy Panama. The prices listed below shall include all labor, service, equipment, technical support, materials, insurance (see FAR 52.228 -4 and 52.228- 5), overhead, and profit. The Government will pay the Contractor on a monthly basis for routine services that have been satisfactorily performed. The Contractor shall ensure that all services are delivered with high availability, reliability, and performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. The Contractor shall offer two different plans to fulfill the Government needs: Basic Plan. Pay per use for actual calls (local, local long distance, international long distance), incoming and outgoing roaming calls, incoming and outgoing local SMS, incoming and outgoing international SMS, incoming and outgoing roaming SMS. Unlimited Smart Phones & Tablets Plan. A flat monthly rate per cellphone line that includes unlimited: local data, local minutes on-net, local minutes off-net, national long-distance minutes,

ta export of invoices in .csv or Excel format every month • Internet browsing for wireless handheld devices • Unassigned blank SIM cards for future issuance or replacement, and the ability to provision eSIM-enabled devices on demand • Wi-Fi Calling (Voice over Wi-Fi) • Unrestricted mobile hotspot (tethering) capability without additional charges, separate data allowances, or reduced speeds. • Cellular coverage with sufficient indoor signal strength to support reliable service throughout all office areas within the U.S. Embassy compound The Contractor shall ensure that services provided through its network are delivered with high availability, reliability, voice clarity, and data performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. Mobile & Data Services 19PM0726Q0012 Page 10 of 11 The Contractor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to promptly identify, mitigate, and resolve network problems affecting Government services. The COR shall be informed as soon as reasonably possible of significant outages, degradations, and service restoration status. CALLS WITHIN PANAMA The Contractor shall pro

reliable international voice connectivity on a 24 -hour basis to the United States, Latin America, Europe, and other international destinations where commercially available telecommunications services exist. International calling services shall support clear and reliable voice communications consistent with the best commercial practices for enterprise telecommunications services. INTERNATIONAL ROAMING The Contractor shall provide broad international roaming coverage for voice, SMS, and data services through commercially established roaming agreements with foreign mobile network operators. Emphasis shall be placed on roaming availability and service reliability throughout the Western Hemisphere. The Contractor shall support international roaming services compatible with 4G/LTE services, and/or 5G services (5G services where commercially available). The Contractor shall provide the COR with an updated list of current international roaming partners and supported roaming countries at least every six (6) months. The Contractor shall disclose any significant roaming restrictions, unsupported regions, or service limitations in its proposal. SMS MESSAGING The Contractor shall provide reliable SMS messaging services on a 24- hour basis, including domestic, inter

ns and changes, lost or stolen device r eporting, billing inquiries, and service troubleshooting. The Contractor shall provide dedicated account management and support personnel who are fluent in both English and Spanish. The Contractor shall provide a dedicated customer support email address for the U.S. Embassy Panama. Mobile & Data Services 19PM0726Q0012 Page 12 of 13 In addition to email support, the Contractor shall provide 24/7 customer support through WhatsApp messaging and telephone support, with response times not exceeding one (1) hour for critical service issues. Current-state constraints relevant to forward-looking scoping include a single-host deployment in which compute, scheduling, and the database run on one Linux host; manual rather than scheduled refresh of the Zephyr test-management data; and a derived- views and analytics layer that is still maturing. The average TI.com compute utilization is 15.3% (total compute available is ~2,600,000 MHz) and the average TI.mil compute utilization is 12.4% (total compute available is ~1,250,000 MHz). TI.com average storage utilization is 38.2% (total storage available is ~470 TiB) and TI.mil average storage utilization is 18.7% (total storage available is ~425 TiB). The equipment used to provision resource pools (i.e., servers and networking and storage devices) is owned by DHMS. A complete hardware inventory for both the METIC and the DDC is provided as an attachment, enumerating manufacturer, asset description, sub- type, quantity, and location for each item. Lifecycle posture is described in Section 2.9. The ESS environment supports approximately 2,400 virtual machines across two virtualization environments, designated TI.com and TI.mil. The TI.com environment hosts approximately 70 percent of the total VM count; TI.mil hosts the remainder. A third VDI- speciﬁc vCenter exists but is currently offline. 8 The two environments share a converged physical infrastructure rather than running on physically separated host pools. Individual hypervisor hosts within the TI.com environment routinely serve workloads from both the TI.com and TI.mil VM populations, and s

vironment routinely serve workloads from both the TI.com and TI.mil VM populations, and shared networks carry traffic from both. Workload separation between the two environments is logical rather than physical. Recent utilization metrics indicate that approximately one-third of the total VM inventory is powered off but retained. Of the active, powered-on VMs, a portion operate at near-zero CPU utilization, resulting in approximately half of the aggregate VM inventory showing minimal active operational use. Additionally, current utilization data indicates that some active VMs are conﬁgured with capacity exceeding their actual workload requirements, while storage capacity is occupied by long-retained snapshots and thin-provisioning overhead. The current VM inventory spans two governance layers. Core ESS infrastructure VMs are managed under the ESS infrastructure project's authority. Program-supported VMs, including but not limited to those associated with DHMSM, JOMIS, EIDS, and FEHRM- managed workloads, are managed under their respective program's authority and require program engagement for any disposition. To complete the analysis, the Defense Healthcare Management Systems (DHMS) engineering leaders visited the testing site to understand the physical layout and how the testers use the devices and equipment, reviewed technical diagrams, studied test use cases, and gathered inventories of the equipment used across the ESS environment. Based on the above research, the services and capabilities have been divided into six sections: • Section 1: The physical environment itself, the Medical Enterprise Test Innovation Center (METIC) 1 is the physical testing location designed for employees and vendors (either virtually or in person) to manage and run tests to support DHMS health care technology. The scope of this includes the physical location, furnishings, electricity, heating and cooling, management of physical equipment, and physical testing layout. • Section 2: The computer infrastructure includes network connectivity and conﬁguration, compute resources, storage, speciﬁc medical devices used for testing, laptops, mobile devices and security services. • Section 3: Testing has three sections. cooling, and electrical wiring to properly support the equipment. The remaining 52% accommodates nine offices, a kitchen, two conference rooms (20 person and 8 person) and touchdown workspaces for up to 30 support personnel. The large conference room includes audio-visual capability and videoconferencing for meetings and whiteboards used for technical discussions. A small percentage of the space hosts a reception area with a badge-only door behind it that is used to access the facility. The average number of people using the facility for testing is 30 per day, while at peak test events, the number can increase to 75 testers per day onsite. In total, there are 184 active users of the TI.com environment and 308 active users of the TI.mil environment (includes development vendors) who can participate on site or through remote connections. Nous certifions que les comptes annuels sont, au regard des règles et principes comptables français, réguliers et sincères et donnent une image fidèle du résultat des opérations de l’exercice écoulé ainsi que de la situation financière et du patrimoine de l’établissement à la fin de cet exercice. Fondement de l'opinion Référentiel d'audit Nous avons effectué notre audit selon les normes d'exercice professionnel applicables en France. Nous estimons que les éléments que nous avons collectés sont suffisants et appropriés pour fonder notre opinion. Les responsabilités qui nous incombent en vertu de ces normes sont indiquées dans la partie "Responsabilités des commissaires aux comptes relatives à l'audit des comptes annuels" du présent rapport. is en matière de gestion financière et comptable aux règles applicables aux entreprises industrielles et commerciales » (L. 5312-8, alinéa 1er). Les agents de droit privé de France Travail, bien que chargés d’une mission de service public, sont régis par le code du Travail dans les conditions particulières prévues par une Convention Collective Nationale agréée par les ministres chargés de l’emploi et du budget. Les agents n’ayant pas opté restent soumis au décret N° 2003- 1370 de décembre 2013 qui fixe les dispositions applicables aux agents de droit public. En matière fiscale, France Travail a été reconnu par la Direction de la législation fiscale, comme un établissement public administratif d’assistance. A ce titre et en vertu du Code général des impôts, France Travail se voit par conséquent exonéré de l’impôt sur les sociétés, de la contribution sur les revenus locatifs, des droits d’enregistrement, de la taxe foncière, de la taxe d’habitation et de la taxe d’enlèvement des ordures ménagères. De même, ses activités ne sont pas assujetties à la TVA. The purpose of this procedure is to establish a Panel of Trainers for the provision of Training Services for the Local Enterprise Office in Leitrim County Council. LEO Leitrim is compiling a panel of trainers, from which future training programmes, workshops and seminars for a maximum of a 3 year period will be selected . Applications are invited from those with appropriate skills and experience that wish to be included in the LEO Leitrim Training panel. For the purposes of this document, the term “Trainer” refers to any Applicant admitted to the Panel and engaged by Local Enterprise Office Leitrim to deliver training services. References to Tenderer, Consultant or Applicant shall be interpreted accordingly. The proposed Training Services include but are not limited to those set out in section below. The Leitrim Local Enterprise Office serves as a first stop shop to provide support and services to start, grow and develop micro and small businesses in County Leitrim. LEO Leitrim Training Services are aimed at improving owner-manager skills to assist the survival and growth of micro- businesses. As per the Enterprise Development Plan, the provision of training is a fundamental aspect of LEO supports to entrepreneurs in the county. The Local Enterprise Office cur

Therefore, the service is not fully subject to the provisions of Directive 2014/24/EU. Given the strategic partnership of this service, the Contracting Authority considers the creation of a Panel as the most appropriate and workable procurement process for the provision of eBooks. A Panel constitutes a means of assessing the financial and technical capacity of a number of economic operators to whom individual contracts may or may not be awarded over the Panel’s duration. The Contracting Authority is planning to run a two-stage tender process. In the initial stage, all providers who meet the Selection Criteria included in the Qualification Questionnaire Document will be admitted to the Panel. The second stage of this competition is Contracts. Contracts will be signed by the Contracting Authority with each provider, identifying the terms and conditions including the scope of the services, costs and any other operations terms required. This panel competition is for the provision of Entrepreneurship Training Services to support the ARC Hub for ICT, TU Dublin. The panel will be used to appoint suitably qualified service providers to deliver structured entrepreneurship training to publicly funded ICT translational research teams. Overview of Requirements 2.1 About the ARC Hub for ICT The ARC Hub for ICT has been established to create a thriving entrepreneurial pathway for Irish ICT research, with a vision of connecting academic research outputs to innovation, entrepreneurship, and commercialisation. Led by TU Dublin, Ireland’s largest technological university, the Hub is positioned as a national resource to help researchers transform their work into impactful solutions. The position of the Hub within the Irish publicly funded ICT research ecosystem is to play a bridging role between ICT research supported by Research Ireland Research Centres (RCs) and Centres for Research Training (CRTs) and the next stage of entrepreneurial or commercial activity. This is particularly timely, as a large number of PhD graduates are now emerging from these programmes, generating a surge in ICT re

ovation, entrepreneurship, and commercialisation. Led by TU Dublin, Ireland’s largest technological university, the Hub is positioned as a national resource to help researchers transform their work into impactful solutions. The position of the Hub within the Irish publicly funded ICT research ecosystem is to play a bridging role between ICT research supported by Research Ireland Research Centres (RCs) and Centres for Research Training (CRTs) and the next stage of entrepreneurial or commercial activity. This is particularly timely, as a large number of PhD graduates are now emerging from these programmes, generating a surge in ICT research outputs ready for translation. The Hub will support both centre-affiliated and independent researchers across Ireland, thanks to its collaborative structure with multiple universities, technological universities, and partner organisations. It acts as a pre-commercialisation platform, enabling researchers to build skills, secure funding, and develop prototypes before moving on to full-scale entrepreneurial ventures. The ARC Hub for ICT has identified five thematic pillars with the highest potential for growth and societal impact. The relationship between these thematic pillars and the three support bases provided by the Hub is illustrated in Fig

should follow international best practice (UK/US university–entrepreneur models) across three key stages and is structured to equip research teams with the skills to bring innovations to market. 2.2 Training Programme Overview The Training Programme supports translational research teams in progressing innovations from concept validation through customer validation to spin-out formation. The programme includes three key stages: - Stage 1: Value Proposition Development - Stage 2a: Customer Validation and Business Model Development - Stage 3: Spinning Out The successful Panel Member will facilitate, deliver and report on all activities and outputs associated with these stages, in collaboration with the Spin-Out Manager and ARC Hub operations team. The programme is designed to build entrepreneurial capability, validate commercial potential and prepare suitable projects for spin‑out formation or licensing. 2.3 Expected Learning Outcomes On completion of the programme, participants will be expected to demonstrate understanding and practical application of: Value proposition development Customer discovery Lean business model canvas Minimum viable products (MVPs) Technology readiness levels (TRLs) Problem Solution Fit Market validation Term Sheet Capitalization Table Spin‑out formation

Overview of Requirements 2.1 About the ARC Hub for ICT The ARC Hub for ICT has been established to create a thriving entrepreneurial pathway for Irish ICT research, with a vision of connecting academic research outputs to innovation, entrepreneurship, and commercialisation. Led by TU Dublin, Ireland’s largest technological university, the Hub is positioned as a national resource to help researchers transform their work into impactful solutions. The position of the Hub within the Irish publicly funded ICT research ecosystem is to play a bridging role between ICT research supported by Research Ireland Research Centres

hip, and commercialisation. Led by TU Dublin, Ireland’s largest technological university, the Hub is positioned as a national resource to help researchers transform their work into impactful solutions. The position of the Hub within the Irish publicly funded ICT research ecosystem is to play a bridging role between ICT research supported by Research Ireland Research Centres (RCs) and Centres for Research Training (CRTs) and the next stage of entrepreneurial or commercial activity. This is particularly timely, as a large number of PhD graduates are now emerging from these programmes, generating a surge in ICT research outputs ready for translation. The Hub will support both centre-affiliated and independent researchers across Ireland, thanks to its collaborative structure with multiple universities, technological universities, and partner organisations. It acts as a pre-commercialisation platform, enabling researchers to build skills, secure funding, and develop prototypes before moving on to full-scale entrepreneurial ventures. The ARC Hub for ICT has identified five thematic pillars with the highest potential for growth and societal impact. The relationship between these thematic pillars and the three support bases provided by the Hub is illustrated in Figure 3 below. A c

A comprehensive training and mentoring package underpins the Hub’s approach to developing hypothesis-driven value propositions, business models, and customer discovery. Delivered by the successful bidder, the programme should follow international best practice (UK/US university–entrepreneur models) across three key stages and is structured to equip research teams with the skills to bring innovations to market. 2.2 Training Programme Overview The Training Programme supports translational research teams in progressing innovations from concept validation through customer validation to spin-out formation. To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. entity_geography.text: ealthcare Training Services Contract or concession notice – standard regime 1 Buyer 1.1 Buyer Official name: Leading Healthcare Providers Skillnet Legal type of the buyer: Body governed by public law, controlled by a central government authority Activity of the contracting authority: Education 2 Procedure 2.1 Procedure Title: 2026 ­ 2028 Dynamic Purchasing System for Healthcare Training Services Description: LHP Skillnet is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) to facilitate the provision of services for the period 2026 to 2028. The DPS will provide an ongoing mechanism that allows suitably qualified suppliers who meet the minimum eligibility and quality thresholds to apply for admission at any time during the life of the system. Unlike a traditional framework agreement, the DPS is fully electronic and remains open throughout its duration. Once admitted to the DPS, suppliers may be invited to participate in mini competitions for specific training requirements as they arise. Contracts will be awarded following these mini competitions in accordance with the applicable procurement rules. The DPS will operate in line with the provisions of the relevant procurement directives and will remain in place for a period of three years. Suppliers may join or leave the DPS at any stage du

Introduction: The Portland Area Indian Health Service provides access to health care for an estimated 150, 000 American Indian/Alaska Native residents of Oregon, Washington, and Idaho. The Portland Area Indian Health Service operates four Federal Health Facilities in five Tribal Communities and one at Chemawa Indian School. The Health Centers provide a wide range of clinical services and are open 40 hours each week. The WSSU requires the procurement of a Topcon Maestro2 with Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography (OCTA) for the optometry department. 2. Background: At Warm Springs Service Unit (WSSU)

equire contract to provide equipment, warranty, software & upgrades, support services, installation, calibration, and provide on-stie training at WSSU. The OCTA is used to scan for and diagnose conditions in the retina and vascular structures of the eye. This camera will enhance diagnostic accuracy and clinical efficiency, it offers non-invasive, high resolution imaging of retinal and optic nerve structures enabling early detection and monitoring of ocular disease. 3. Over the past decade, this ecosystem has expanded organically through project ‑by‑project deployments. As a result, the current environment is characterised by fragmentation, inconsistent branding, duplication of operational and hosting costs, varied technical standards, and increasingly complex governance and content‑management structures. A preliminary mapping exercise conducted by MTA has identified more than thirty (30) digital assets, including consumer‑facing websites, corporate platforms, country‑specific domains (e.g., 14 Unclassified France, Germany, Italy, the UK, Japan, Korea, and others), MICE ‑focused portals, event ‑driven microsites, and international representative sites. These range from high ‑traffic multilingual portals such as VisitMalta.com to legacy campaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal syst

mpaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal systems supporting media management, CRM, B2B services, and training. Social media channels and API ‑based integrations further contribute to the broader content flow and technical landscape. MTA’s strategic direction is to consolidate this extensive and heterogeneous digital landscape under a unified and coherent platform centred around VisitMalta.com. The objective is to improve user experience, reinforce consistent brand representation across all markets, streamline content and technical governance, and reduce long‑term operational, maintenance, and hosting costs. To support this strategic shift, MTA requires a comprehensive Web Environment Analysis and Requirements Definition Exercise. It shall assess the current ecosystem in full, map underlying systems and content flows, identify consolidation and rationalisation opportunities, and define the technical, functional, governance, integration, and procurement requirements. The USSF currently operates and supports satellite operation centers at Peterson Space Force Base (PSFB), Schriever Space Force Base (SSFB), Colorado, remote tracking stations and other command and control facilities around the world. USSF personnel monitor satellites during launch, put satellites in their proper orbits following launch, and operate the satellites while they are in orbit, ensuring effective and efficient satellite operations and proper disposal of the satellites at the end of life. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

Data Acquisition Outputs for the required Data Processing Services will be made available by Marine Institute in the requisite formats within one week of the contract award. Preliminary processing results for evaluation and acceptance by the Marine Institute are required within 6 weeks of data being made available, with final deliverables to be made available within 2 weeks of Marine Institute assessment and acceptance of preliminary processing results. Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Heastamise võimalus on ettevõtjal juh

esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Products must be issued on a first-in, first-out basis unless otherwise specified or directed by DLA Energy. Non-conforming products must be reported to the COR immediately. The contractor must maintain a complete set on-site of petroleum laboratory test equipment. The contractor is responsible for the testing of fuels within the bulk storage located at the SELF and the COCO facilities. Tratamiento de datos. 1. Obligaciones generales y obligaciones del prestador de servicios como encargado del tratamiento. El adjudicatario se comp romete a cumplir, en el desarrollo de sus funciones, la normativa vigente relativa a la protección de datos personales y, en particular, el Reglamento (UE) 2016/679, de 27 de abril, relativo a la protección de las personas físicas en lo que respecta al tratamiento de datos personales y la libre circulación de esos datos en adelante RGPD), la Ley Orgánica 3/2018, de 5 de diciembre, de Protección de Datos Personales y garantía de los derechos digitales (en adelante LOPDGDD) y demás disposiciones complementarias. El adjudicatario está obligado a mantener la más absoluta confidencialidad y reserva sobre todos aquellos datos y documentos relacionados con el contrato que maneje. Esta obligación subsistirá aún después de finalizada la ejecución del contrato. En todo caso, el adjudicatario accederá únicamente a la información mínima e imprescindible para la ejecución del contrato, aunque las herramientas informáticas permitan un acceso mayor. Existirá una relación act

citada normativa, la adjudicataria queda obligada a informar a su personal del deber de guardar secreto sobre los datos de carácter personal y cualesquiera informaciones o circunstancias relativas a las personas cuyos datos pudiera conocer por razón de su trabajo. El adjudicatario seguirá, respecto de los datos, las concretas instrucciones que reciba de la unidad gestora del contrato, no aplicando o utilizando dichos datos con finalidades distintas a las especificadas y no comunicando a ningún tercero, ni siquiera para su conservación, los datos facilitados. Si el adjudicatario considera que alguna de las instrucciones infringe el RGPD, la LOPDGDD o cualquier otra disposición en materia de protección de datos de la Unión o los Estados miembros, informará inmediatamente al SNS-O. Asimismo, la adjudicataria se compromete a tomar las medidas ne cesarias para la buena conservación de la información y del material de cualquier tipo suministrado o perteneciente al Servicio Navarro de Salud - Osasunbidea, garantizar su confidencialidad, su integridad y disponibilidad y la resiliencia permanente de los sistemas de tratamiento en caso de incidencia física o técnica. Las medidas de seguridad con las que se cuente de modo constante, además de las ya citadas referidas al per

me a las instrucciones dictadas por la unidad gestora del contrato. Así mismo, entregará los datos de carácter personal y clínico, originados como consecuencia de la asistencia prestada a los pacientes, al Servicio Navarro de Salud -Osasunbidea, siguiendo las citadas instrucciones. 6. Rozwiązanie musi udostępniać wbudowaną technologię do ochrony przed rootkitami aktywnymi oraz ukrywającymi się w systemie. Rozwiązanie musi udostępniać ochronę przed podłączeniem hosta do sieci botnet. Rozwiązanie musi udostępniać funkcjonalność automatycznego przywracania plików po ich zaszyfrowaniu przez oprogramowanie typu ransomware: technologia ta musi być autorskim rozwiązaniem producenta oprogramowania ochrony stacji roboczych, technologia umożliwiająca przywrócenie plików po ich zaszyfrowaniu nie może wykorzystywać mechanizmu systemowego VSS (Volume Shadow Copy Service), technologia, która tworzy kopię zapasową plików, musi działać w czasie rzeczywistym i zabezpieczać pliki przed nieautoryzowaną modyfikacją przez podejrzane procesy. Rozwiązanie musi udostępniać skanowanie w czasie rzeczywistym otwieranych, zapisywanych i wykonywanych plików. Rozwiązanie musi udostępniać skanowanie na żądanie, z menu kontekstowego oraz zgodnie z harmonogramem co najmniej: całego dysku, wybranych katalogów, pojedynczych plików, plików spakowanych oraz skompresowanych, dysków sieciowych, dysków przenośnych/wymiennych. Rozwiązanie musi posiadać opcję umieszczenia na liście wykluczeń ze skanowania co najmnie

Mechanizm równoważenia obciążenia łącza internetowego musi działać w oparciu o dwa mechanizmy: równoważenie względem adresu źródłowego oraz równoważenie względem połączenia. W zakresie SD-WAN urządzenie musi zapewniać obsługę mechanizmu SLA obejmującego monitorowanie opóźnienia, jittera oraz wskaźnika utraty pakietów. Urządzenie musi umożliwiać trasowanie pakietów z poziomu wybranej reguły firewall (Policy Based Routing). In accordance with this Contract and its annexes, the Seller designs the Trams, manufactures them and transports them at its own expense to the Republic of Estonia, delivering the Trams together with all Tram documents (including working drawings) to the Buyer in Tallinn, at the address Vana-Lõuna 41 or at another address specified by the Buyer. The Seller confirms that the ownership of the Trams, special devices, spare parts and other items to be delivered under the Contract belongs to the Seller and that no third party has any rights to them and that no third party has any basis for claiming any such rights. The Seller undertakes to coordinate with the Buyer in writing the interior and exterior design of the Trams to be delivered by submitting a 3D model of the Tram to the Buyer before commencing the design of the Trams. The Seller undertakes to ensure that the Tram's exterior and interior design solutions are based on modern vehicle solutions, meet modern product design expectations and fit into Tallinn's urban space.

Canada prefers a common LCM design for both Polar Icebreakers. Respondents may nevertheless indicate whether they are able to supply both LCMs or only one LCM for delivery to one of the two preliminary locations, which are expected to be in the Vancouver, British Columbia area and the Québec City, Québec area. sla_onsite.text: ivilegiums prinsipp. Privilegerte kontoer skal være særskilt sikret, og løsningen skal støtte opprettelse, endring, sperring og periodisk kontroll av tilganger. Må-krav 3.8 Løsningen skal støtte effektiv administrasjon av brukere og tilganger. Må-krav Side 15 av 20 Løsningen skal ha funksjonalitet for opprettelse, endring, sperring og deaktiver- ing av brukere og tilganger. Leverandøren skal svare ja dersom dette støttes i standardløsningen. Leverandøren skal beskrive hvordan løsningen kan inte- greres med Kundens identitetsforvaltning for opprettelse, endring, sperring og deaktivering av brukere og tilganger. 3.9 Løsningen skal logge oppslag, lesing, opprettelse, endring, utskrift, eksport og administrativ tilgang til pasientopplysninger. Loggen skal vise hvem som utførte handlingen, tidspunkt, pasient eller data, og hvilken handling som ble utført. Autoriserte representanter for Kunden skal kunne søke i, filtrere og eksportere logger uten bistand fra leverandøren. Loggene skal beskyttes mot uautorisert endring og sletting. Må-krav 3.10 Helse- og personopplysninger skal krypteres under overføring og ved lagring ved bruk av anerkjente og oppdaterte metoder. Leverandøren skal ha dokumenterte rutiner for sikker oppbevaring, tilgang, utskifting og tilbakekalling av kryptering

Må-krav 4.4 Vedlikehold, feilretting, sikkerhetsoppdateringer og ordinære versjonsopp- graderinger skal inngå i tjenesten. Endringer som påvirker arbeidsflyt, integrasjoner eller tilgjengelighet, skal nor- malt varsles minst ti virkedager på forhånd og følges av oppdatert dokumen- tasjon. Sikkerhetskritiske oppdateringer kan gjennomføres med kortere varsel. Må-krav 4.5 Leverandøren skal levere periodiske rapporter over tilgjengelighet, hendelser, responstider, åpne supportsaker, gjennomførte endringer og eventuelle avvik fra SLA. Kunden skal ved behov kunne kreve oppfølgingsmøte om drift og tjenestek- valitet. Må-krav 4.6 Ved avtalens opphør skal leverandøren bistå med kontrollert overgang til Kunden eller ny leverandør. Kundens data, metadata, logger og nødvendig dokumentasjon skal utleveres i dokumenterte, strukturerte og lesbare formater. Tilgang skal opprettholdes i avtalt overgangsperiode, og sletting skal dokumenteres etter Kundens godkjen- ning. Må-krav 4.7 Kvalitet Side 17 av 20 Forbedrede tjenestenivåer: Leverandøren skal beskrive tilbudte tjenestenivåer utover minimumskravene. Legevakten er lokalisert i Kombinasjonsbygget ved Sykehuset i Levanger, adresse: Kirkegata 2D, 7600 Levanger. Kritiske feil skal være rettet før produksjonssetting. Leverandøren skal stille med forsterket oppfølging ved produksjonssetting og i minst to uker etterpå, samt ha en dokumentert tilbakeføringsplan. Må-krav 6. Pris og prisbestemmelser Nr. Krav Type 6.1 Leverandøren skal fylle ut Kundens prisskjema og spesifisere engangskostnader, periodiske kostnader, eventuelle transaksjonspriser, tredjepartskostnader, inte- grasjoner, datakonvertering, opplæring og andre kostnadselementer. Alle priser skal oppgis ekskl. merverdiavgift. Må-krav 6.2 Prisene skal være faste til 12 måneder etter leveringsdagen. Deretter kan løpende priser reguleres én gang per år, begrenset oppad til en- dringen i Statistisk sentralbyrås konsumprisindeks, totalindeksen. Prisreduksjon i indeksen skal gi tilsvarende reduksjon. Regulering skal varsles skriftlig minst 30 dager på forhånd. Må-krav 6.3 Kostnader som ikke fremgår av tilbudet, kan ikke faktureres. Eventuelle opsjoner og timepriser for særskilt bestilte tilleggstjenester skal oppgis separat. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. In the case of a Quick Quote or the second stage of a dual stage procedure you must have been invited by the buyer to submit a response. Postbox Response Workspace All postbox re

The aptitudes and abilities measured by the ASVAB include General Science, Arithmetic Reasoning, Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension, Mathematics Knowledge, Electronics Information, Auto Information, Shop Information, Mechanical Comprehension, and Assembling Objects. Test takers receive a standardized score from 1-100 for each of these subtests. The Army combines scores on the ASVAB subtests into composites, also known as aptitude areas (AAs) or line scores, to determine eligibility into each initial-entry MOS. For example, a Soldier would be eligible to enlist in the Fire Control Specialist MOS (13J) if they score an 83 on the Field Artillery composite AA that includes the subtests Arithmetic Reasoning, Mathematics Knowledge, and Mechanical Comprehension. There are currently 10 AA composites that are used to determine MOS eligibility: Clerical, Combat, Electronics, Field Artillery, General Maintenance, General Technical, Mechanical Maintenance, Operators and Food, Surveillance and Communications, and Skilled Technical. The Army combines scores on the ASVAB subtests into composites, also known as aptitude areas (AAs) or line scores, to determine eligibility into each initial-entry MOS. For example, a Soldier would be eligible to enlist in the Fire Control Specialist MOS (13J) if they score an 83 on the Field Artillery composite AA that includes the subtests Arithmetic Reasoning, Mathematics Knowledge, and Mechanical Comprehension. There are currently 10 AA composites that are used to determine MOS eligibility: Clerical, Combat, Electronics, Field Artillery, General Maintenance, General Technical, Mechanical Maintenance, Operators and Food, Surveillance and Communications, and Skilled Technical. Effective classification and assignment of Soldiers is dependent on being able to discriminate the different abilities of Soldiers based on how well they score on the AA composites of the ASVAB. The overarching objective of this effort is to conduct research to determine if the Army would benefit from updated AA composites used to determine MOS fit. The current project aims to identify potential redundancy within the current ASVAB AA composites,

The multi-domain operations (MDO) concept requires Army teams to operate semi-independently but also to utilize the capabilities across multiple domains to conduct sustained missions in highly contested environments. Additionally, high personnel turnover for teams is expected in the FOE as casualty counts increase, rapid teaming is required, and ad hoc teams become common. Teams must be capable of maintaining mission effectiveness despite this expected high personnel turnover. Within the literature, creativity has been conceptualized and examined as both an antecedent (e.g., Yang & Hung, 2021; Zhang & Bartol, 2010) and an outcome (e.g., Liu et al., 2022; Tierney & Farmer, 2011). In a recent review by Lua et al. (2024), the authors discuss creativity behaviors like idea implementation, innovative behavior, and personal initiative. Teng et al. (2020) examined the relationship between creative self-efficacy and innovative behavior. In the study, the authors used Scott and Bruce’s (1994) measure of innovative behaviors which includes items such as “generates creative ideas” and “develops adequate plans and schedules for the implementation of new ideas” (p. 607). For the purpose of this effort, we are interested in creativity as an outcome and, more specifically, creative performance with technology. Creativity research is not novel to the U.S. Army, but largely exists at the antecedent level. Two previous job analysis projects included innovation and creativity in surveys of talent requirements (Boyle et al., 2022) and personnel characteristics (Royston & Lin, 2022) across military occupational specialties (MOS). Additional ARI efforts have examined divergent thinking (Russell et al., 2017) and creative thinking (Zaccaro et al., 2012). Results for these reports indicate the importance of creativity across MOS and ranks but are not specific to creative performance behaviors with technology. 4 The purpose of this project is to develop and validate a measure of creative performance with technology. Measure items should capture individual-level indicators of creative performance that are relevant for Soldiers. This measure may capture a single domain or may involve multiple subscales. Nothing in these Rules is intended to give any person who is not a Party any right to enforce any provision of the Rules, or to confer any legally protected benefit on any such person. Severability. If at any time any provision of the Rules becomes illegal, invalid or unenforceable in any respect under the law of any jurisdiction, neither the legality, validity or enforceability of the remaining provisions of the Rules nor the legality, validity or enforceability of such provision under the law of any other jurisdiction shall in any way be affected or impaired thereby. Binding effect of determinations. Any certification or determination by NODES of a rate or amount under the Rules shall, in the absence of manifest error and except as otherwise set out in the Rules, be conclusive evidence of the matters to which it relates. In any proceedings arising out of or in connection with the Rules, the entries made in the accounts maintained by NODES will be prima facie evidence of the matters to which they relate. Non-waiver of rights. No failure of a party to exercise, nor any delay on its part in exercising, any of its rights (in whole or in part) under the Rules shall operate as a waiver of the party’s rights or remedies upon that or any subsequent occasion. Para los contratos administrativos especiales, y de acuerdo con la doctrina emanada de tribunales y órganos consultivos de contratación, el valor estimado del contrato se corresponderá con el volumen de negocio neto. SEGUNDA.- La disposición adicional octava, en su apartado e), de la Ley 7/1985, de 2 de abril, reguladora de las Bases del Régimen Local, dispone que las funciones que la legislación sobre contratos de las Administraciones Públicas asigna a los Secretarios de los Ayuntamientos, corresponderán al titular de la asesoría jurídica, salvo las de formalización de los contratos en documento administrativo y, todo ello, en relación a los municipios de gran población. TERCERA.- El Reglamento de la Asesoría Jurídica del Ayuntamiento de Albacete (BOP núm. 16, de 10 de febrero de 2.014), en su artículo 2, apartado 2º, f), establece que corresponde a la Dirección de la Asesoría Jurídica la emisión de informe jurídico y demás funciones que la legislación de contratos de las Administraciones Públicas asigna a la Secretar
